questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to cook cheap, healthy meals for young children
Why supermarkets are becoming more expensive
The history of fizzy drinks in Britain
What ultra-processed food is and if we should eat it
questions.why: They discuss what ultra-processed foods are, why they're popular and whether we should avoid them.

questions.q: Why have ultra-processed foods been linked to poor health?
options: They are usually eaten late at night
They often contain a lot of sugar and salt
They contain too much fruit
They are often cooked in a microwave
questions.why: Pippa says they often contain lots of sugar and salt and are linked to obesity and diabetes.

questions.q: According to Annabel Rackham, how can you recognise ultra-processed food?
options: It has five or more ingredients, some unusual
It is always sold frozen in plastic packets
It always tastes very sweet or very salty
It has fewer than five simple ingredients
questions.why: She says they contain five or more ingredients and things you wouldn't find in your average kitchen.

options: She now eats more ready meals because she's busy
She has stopped eating chocolate completely
She ate a lot of processed food but now cooks
She now only eats fresh fruit and vegetables
questions.why: She says she used to eat a lot of ultra-processed foods and now tries to cook everything herself.

questions.q: Why does Phil try to cook with normal ingredients?
options: Because it's cheaper
So he knows exactly what's in his food
Because his family asks him to
Because he enjoys cooking for hours
questions.why: He says he cooks with normal ingredients 'just so you know what's gone into it'.

questions.q: What does Annabel think is the main reason people eat ultra-processed food?
options: It's much healthier than most people think
Doctors often recommend it to busy patients
It lasts much longer in the fridge than fresh food
It's convenient and quicker than cooking
questions.why: She says convenience is the main issue: a ready meal takes minutes, but cooking from scratch takes long.

questions.q: What is Annabel's advice about eating ultra-processed food?
options: Don't panic; a little of it is fine
Cut it out of your diet completely
Only eat it at weekends or on holiday
Eat it instead of snacks between meals
questions.why: She says the best thing is 'not to panic. Everything is fine in moderation.'

questions.q: How does Phil react to Annabel's advice?
options: He disagrees and says we should avoid all snacks
He says he will stop eating chocolate for good
He's pleased he can still have chocolate sometimes
He thinks the advice is confusing and unclear
questions.why: Phil says it sounds sensible and means he won't feel bad eating chocolate now and then.
